newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ACT Networks raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ACT Networks raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist analyst Joe Noel raised his rating on the shares of ACT Networks Inc to a strong buy from a buy based on an "attractive valuation" relative to its peers in the telecommunications industry.

-- In a written statement, Noel said he believes new products and a strong relationship with computer network equipment maker Cisco Systems Inc provide the potential for upside surprise opportunities.
-- He also said the overall growth in frame relay markets will continue to propel the company's growth, provided the company's management executes its business plan.
